reddit.title: Improving Performance in Provincia: Cutting Flowing Water Costs
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on optimizing flowing water in Provincia! By refining how we handle wet cells, we've significantly reduced script time for flowing lakes. For instance, a 64×64 lake's processing time has dropped from about 20 ms to just 12 ms. This improvement means smoother gameplay without compromising on depth accuracy. Learn more about these changes and their impact on performance here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
